codes.title: Deep vein thrombosis
evidence_quotes: Left calf swollen, warm and tender after a 14-hour bus journey from Mombasa, pain on dorsiflexion.
codes.reasoning: The patient presents with classic signs of deep vein thrombosis (unilateral calf swelling, warmth, tenderness, and pain on dorsiflexion) after a 14-hour bus trip. Per GDL-021, this clinical pattern strongly points to DVT, though definitive objective testing remains pending.
